release_name: Live TV v5.2.5 (Build 60) — SPOTV 2 HD & MotoGP Multi-Server Failover Fix
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🏍️ Fixed SPOTV 2 HD & SPOTV HD Playback: Replaced decommissioned PLDT CDN endpoints with verified 1080p 60fps MotoGP World Feed stream
🏎️ Multi-Server Failover for SPOTV 2: Instant switching between Server 1 (MotoGP World Feed 1080p), Server 2 (TNT Sports 2 HD), and Server 3 (Eurosport Motorsport)
🏁 Verified TNT Sports 1, 2, 3, 4 HD: Restored full DASH + ClearKey DRM streams on fast Akamai CDN
🛡️ Resilient MotoGP Failover: Automated watchdog recovers stream to backup servers without stalling or playback interruption
🎾 Added TSN 1 HD (Rolex Paris Masters) & ESPN 2 Brasil HD with multi-server failover
⇄ Last Channel Toggle & Recall: Alternates between current and previous channels with on-screen button labels and hotkey Q
